great-ocean-road-apollo-bay-run.title: Great Ocean Road · Apollo Bay Run
great-ocean-road-apollo-bay-run.slogan: Cliff-edge coast, rainforest curves and the Twelve Apostles. · out and back
great-ocean-road-apollo-bay-run.story: The coastal section from Torquay to Apollo Bay is the part riders come for: the road runs on a ledge between cliff and surf with bend after bend. Inland through the Otways it turns green and technical. Go midweek - this is one of Australia's busiest tourist roads and the viewpoint car parks fill early.

places-las-casas-de-las-ingenieros-il-ab.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-las-casas-de-las-ingenieros-il-ab.story: From Nerpio it runs 322 km to Nerpio; allow about 5 h 33 of riding. It goes by way of Benizar V, Abrigo del Pozo III, Abrigo del Canto Blanco and Abrigo del mediodía I. The highest point is about 1,350 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
